meta.description: Runs the quarterly analysis graph, then emails the human note and attaches the machine signal. Thin on purpose: every decision lives in the Python, and this workflow only schedules it, reads two files and sends one email. plan.md: 'Optional thin n8n workflow: quarterly trigger plus digest email, credentials in the n8n store.'
notes: CREDENTIALS ARE REFERENCED, NEVER EMBEDDED. The SMTP node names a credential in the n8n store by id; this file carries no password, no API key and no DATABASE_URL. Importing it into a fresh n8n asks you to pick a credential, which is the intended behaviour.
Set PROJECT_DIR in the workflow's variables before the first run.

The schedule is the 20th of February, May, August and November. That is ~50 days after a calendar quarter end, which is roughly when the first filings for that quarter have landed. Running on the quarter end itself would produce a digest about the previous quarter and look like a bug.

nodes.name: Run quarterly graph
nodes.notes: The graph writes docs/_signal.json and docs/quarterly_note.md. It validates the signal against schema_version 1.0 before writing, so a non-zero exit here means nothing was written — which is the behaviour we want.

nodes.name: Signal is schema 1.0?
nodes.notes: A schema_version this workflow does not know is not a digest to send — it is a contract change somebody made. The false branch stops rather than emailing a payload the recipient's tooling cannot parse.

parameters.subject: =Private AI valuations — quarter to {{ $json.data.period.latest_period_end }}

nodes.name: Send digest
nodes.notes: Credential by reference. n8n keeps the secret in its own store; this file never sees it.

parameters.errorMessage: =Quarterly digest halted: signal reports schema_version {{ $json.data.schema_version }}, this workflow knows 1.0. A contract change needs a human before anything is emailed.
